title: New developer: Torrey Searle
html:
The Kamailio project is glad to announce that a new person got developer GIT write access to repository: Torrey Searle, long time community member from Voxbone – he is working and going to add and maintain the sipt module, facilitating operations over SIP-T/SIP-I messages, the patch being on tracker:

  • http://sip-router.org/tracker/index.php?do=details&task_id=281&project=1

His git commit id is: tsearle

Our warm welcome. We are looking forward to future work within the project!
